decision.message: Selected the low_current profile to reduce I2C pull-up current as explicitly requested. Operating limits reflect family defaults, not measured values.

clauses.text: Select the version that reduces I2C pull-up current. I do not mean reducing whole-board power or running on a battery.
clauses.reason: The user explicitly requests the version that reduces I2C pull-up current, which corresponds exactly to the 'low_current' profile with 10k pull-ups. The request excludes whole-board power reduction or battery operation, so these are deliberately not considered. All other fixed design parameters conform to the family constraints.
